description: Generated timeline of historical events from explicit `event_date` front-matter values. Document publication and verification dates appear on individual page footers instead.

events.description: U.S. authorities investigated Phil Zimmermann for years over distribution of Pretty Good Privacy (PGP) encryption software; the Northern District of California U.S. Attorney declined prosecution and closed the investigation in January 1996.
events.record_title: U.S. Criminal Investigation of Phil Zimmermann / PGP (Closed 1996)

events.description: On May 6, 2022, OFAC designated virtual currency mixer Blender.io under E.O. 13694 — Treasury’s first sanctions action against a virtual currency mixer — citing laundering of proceeds linked to DPRK cyber activity.

On July 29, 2026, Russia's FSB charged Telegram founder Pavel Durov with facilitating terrorist activity, alleging Telegram failed to remove channels used to coordinate attacks and sabotage, and placed him on an international wanted list.
events.record_title: Russia FSB Charges Against Pavel Durov / Telegram (July 2026)
